description: A signature ability is one invented ability per evolution family, numbered in the 200000 band and granted rather than rolled at birth. A legendary **group**, a region's **starter trio** and a pair of **counterpart families** each share one theme across their members. Applies whenever designing, naming, implementing or reviewing a signature ability.
